items.claim: Santiago Ponzinibbio is unmotivated and questioning his career future.
items.quote: Santiago Ponzinibbio is talking about, 'Hey, I don't know really what's going to be next for my career.' So, he's not all in.

items.claim: Santiago Ponzinibbio is a clean striker who manages range well and stays out of the pocket.
items.quote: He stays out of the pocket. His striking is clean. Does a good job managing his own range.

items.claim: Santiago Ponzinibbio has a 71% takedown defense.
items.quote: Takedown defense is solid as well 71%.

items.claim: Santiago Ponzinibbio was knocked out late by Danny Rodriguez after being a step behind.
items.quote: He did just get knocked out by Danny Rodriguez pretty late. He was a step behind that entire fight

items.claim: Dustin Jacoby was a top-three ranked professional kickboxer before MMA.
items.quote: He was a professional kickboxer before he moved over to the UFC. And in his professional kickboxing career, he did quite well. He was ranked in top three in the world

items.claim: Dustin Jacoby has good takedown defense.
Dustin Jacoby is vulnerable to being knocked out or dropped.
items.quote: He can be clipped. We've watched him completely flatline like in the Reyes fight.
